entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand. It's garbage and I want my money back. Now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't play games with me. It's not a 'preference', it's that the thing is impossible to navigate! The pulse tracking is so confusing and the whole interface is hard to use. I expected more for what I paid.
I see. It sounds very frustrating when a device isn't intuitive. Did the user manual offer any clarity on that feature?

The user manual is a joke! I've had this for 20 days and I'm done trying to figure it out. Just process the return or get me your manager. I'm one click away from telling everyone on the internet how terrible VeloFit is.
That won't be necessary, I can handle this for you. I completely understand your frustration and I want to make this right. Let me just pull up our official return policy here in my system.

Okay, I'm looking at it now. It says here that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 20, you are well within the window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Seriously? You're just going to do it?

Yes, of course. My apologies for the hassle you've experienced with the device. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label right now. It will be sent to the email address on your account within the next five minutes. Is that okay?
Huh. Yeah, that's fine. So I just print it out and send it back?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued back to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
